name: Team Bulbasaur: Sevii Tides Vanguard
archetype: Sevii oceanic traversal & Chuck duel core — Sleep status control, Levitate Ground immunity, Intimidate physical dampening, Water absorption, and Fighting wallbreaking.
gym_duel_rationale: Chuck challenges the player to a 5 vs 5 duel under the Boon Island waterfall. Slots 1 through 5 form the designated battle squad: Alakazam/Weezing (Slot 5) carries Levitate to float above Earth Power and melts Chuck's Fighting core with STAB Psychic; Venusaur/Charizard (Slot 1) uses Sleep Powder to shut down Belly Drum setup and eliminates Kabutops/Machamp with STAB Petal Dance; Gyarados/Arbok (Slot 4) defangs physical sweepers with Intimidate and lands 100% accurate Glare paralysis; Lapras (Slot 2) walls water attacks with Water Absorb and provides Ice Beam coverage; and Kingler/Primeape (Slot 3) shatters Hitmonchan/Snorlax with STAB Close Combat. Snorlax rests in reserve as the route endurance tank.

roster.progression_notes: 530 BST starter hybrid at Cap 72. Sleep Powder disables Chuck's dangerous setup sweepers on switch-in. STAB Petal Dance obliterates Kabutops/Machamp, while Synthesis provides reliable recovery.
535 BST bulky fortress. Water Absorb completely negates opposing water moves across Brine Road and Deep Sea. STAB Ice Beam targets Lucario/Flygon for heavy super-effective damage.
500 BST physical bruiser. STAB Close Combat shatters Chuck's bulky Hitmonchan/Snorlax anchor. Crabhammer delivers colossal physical water impact against Fire switch-ins.
513 BST Intimidate pivot. Lowers Chuck's physical Attack on entry to neutralize heavy martial artists. Glare inflicts guaranteed 100% paralysis on fast threats.
495 BST Levitate MVP with 118 SpA. Immune to Earth Power via Levitate. STAB Psychic decimates Kabutops/Machamp, Poliwrath/Primeape, Lucario/Flygon, and Hitmonchan/Snorlax for effortless OHKOs.
Colossal 160 HP route sponge holding Leftovers. RestTalk loop absorbs deep-sea status and damage during exploration while resting in reserve during the 5v5 Gym duel.

flex_bench.rationale: 97.5% accurate Sleep Powder for securing wild Sevii and deep-sea catches.
Discharge and Light Screen to sweep ocean water routes and zap opposing flyers.
High Jump Kick physical breaker for Rock and Normal type encounters.
